response.justification: While Bogdan has strong general software engineering credentials with 20+ years of experience and meets the educational requirements, his background is almost entirely in web development, infrastructure, and DevOps rather than the specialized domain required. The role demands deep expertise in AI hardware acceleration, SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and deep learning workload optimization—none of which are evident in his resume. His performance optimization experience, though solid, is in software systems rather than hardware accelerators.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals in system design and performance optimization
Proven ability to optimize complex systems (Dunnhumby's micro-services handling millions of requests/second; Optilyz pricing platform optimization)
Experience with low-level systems and performance-critical code (DLang for high-performance applications; embedded systems work at Altom)
concerns: No demonstrated expertise in AI/deep learning workloads, neural network training, or inference optimization
Career trajectory focused on web development and cloud infrastructure rather than hardware architecture, chip design, or GPU optimization
No evidence of experience with SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture analysis, or accelerator-specific performance profiling tools

key_factors.factor: No hardware architecture or SoC/IP modeling background
